text: dsh-av-sync-gate 是一个 DSH Web 插件，通过 HTTP 接口为解说视频提供声画同步辅助。它根据各段配音时长、帧率和呼吸间隔计算逐段基址、帧数及跨度，也能检查帧号数量并按文本长度为字幕句子分配时间。适合制作旁白视频并希望在拼接前校对画面时长、帧序和字幕节奏的用户。代码未读取 API 密钥，也没有配置外部账号的要求。

dsh-av-sync-gate is a DSH Web plugin for narrated-video timing. Its HTTP endpoint plans frame counts and spans from voiceover durations, frame rate, and a gap. It also checks frame totals and schedules subtitle phrases. Use it to review timing before joining video segments; no API key is read.
我想根据每段旁白时长算出视频需要的帧数。
拼接前帮我发现帧编号缺口，并核对实际帧数是否符合预期。
I need subtitle phrases timed across a voiceover segment based on their character lengths.
dsh-av-sync-gate 的功能「逐段帧计划」：调用 HTTP 接口并传入配音时长、帧率和间隔，即可获得每段基址、帧数、跨度以及总帧数。
dsh-av-sync-gate 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 11 天；提交数 1；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-av-sync-gate README · dsh-av-sync-gate：**Audio-visual sync gate** for narrated slideshow videos. The #1 failure mode:
picture cuts while the voice is still talking, and it drifts worse every
segment. Root cause: visual segments ignore the tail silence between voice
clips. This gate computes the exact frame plan so picture and audio stay
locked, end to end.

dsh-av-sync-gate README · The formula：```
segment_seconds = voiceover_seconds + 0.25   (breath gap, configurable)
frames          = ceil(segment_seconds × fps)
```

dsh-av-sync-gate README · Frame-hole detector：ffmpeg stops encoding at the first missing frame number — a single hole cuts
your video in half. `act=check` compares expected vs actual frame count and
tells you to renumber sequentially before muxing.

dsh-av-sync-gate README · Use：```bash
dsh plugin add github:<owner>/dsh-av-sync-gate
curl "http://127.0.0.1:<port>/av-sync/api?act=plan&durs=4.7,7.2,8.3&fps=30"
curl "http://127.0.0.1:<port>/av-sync/api?act=check&count=1611&expected=1615"
```

dsh-av-sync-gate README · v1.1 · subtitle act (2026-11-01)：`GET /av-sync/api?act=subtitle&text=...&dur=8.8` — splits segment text into
phrases (punctuation stays at the tail of the previous phrase), schedules each
by character-weight proportion across the voiceover window. Powers on-screen
subtitles that switch exactly when the voice says the next phrase.

dsh-av-sync-gate README · Layer rule：Portrait first, text last — text always renders above the character art;
character art ≤50% of frame height, proportional scaling only.
